title: Queuier
body:
# Queuier

A powerful, modern queue plugin for **Velocity** networks.

Queuier lets players queue for full backend servers, view their position in real time, and get automatically connected when space opens. It includes priority queues, bossbar/actionbar displays, AFK handling, admin tools, and optional Multiverse-Core world queue support.

Showcase:

## Installation

Add the .jar file into your velocity plugins.

## Features

- Velocity server queue system
- Priority queue tiers with permissions
- Bossbar and actionbar queue displays
- Queue position and ETA messages
- AFK warning and queue bumping
- Per-server queue limits
- Per-server max-player overrides
- Pause, resume, clear, kick, move, bypass, and list queues
- Configurable MiniMessage messages
- Multiverse-Core world queue support
- NPC/menu friendly commands
- Works well with CitizensCMD and command forwarding plugins
- Command for max players in server, No server restart needed

## Commands

### Player Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/queue join <server>` | Join the queue for a server. |
| `/queue leave` | Leave your current queue. |
| `/queue status` | View your queue position and ETA. |
| `/queue multiverse join <player> <server> <world>` | Queue into a backend server, then teleport to a Multiverse world. |

### Admin Commands

Requires `queuier.admin`.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/queue pause <server>` | Pause a server queue. |
| `/queue resume <server>` | Resume a paused queue. |
| `/queue kick <player>` | Remove a player from their queue. |
| `/queue move <player> <position>` | Move a player to a queue position. |
| `/queue clear <server>` | Clear a server queue. |
| `/queue list [server]` | List active queues or view a specific queue. |
| `/queue add <player> <server>` | Add a player to a queue. |
| `/queue setslots <server> <number>` | Set a runtime max-player override for a server. |
| `/queue bypass <player> [server]` | Send a player past the queue. |
| `/queue reload` | Reload the config. |
| `/queue max_players <amount>` | Amount of players allowed to go through the queue |

## Aliases

| Alias | Description |
|---|---|
| `/q` | Short alias for `/queue`. |


## Multiverse Support

Queuier can send players through a Velocity queue and then teleport them to a specific Multiverse world after they reach the backend server.

Example:

```text
/queue multiverse join <player> main1 world2
```
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Great for NPCs, server selectors, hub menus, and world portals.

## Requirements

Velocity proxy
Java 17+
Optional: Multiverse-Core on backend servers
Optional: backend-to-proxy command forwarding plugin for NPC/menu integrations

2500 multiverse-delay-ms is recomended 

## Why Queuier?

Queuier is built for Minecraft networks that need clean queue control without overcomplicated setup. It is lightweight, configurable, and designed for real player traffic.
